coaches.name: Cole Chance
coaches.headline: Certified yoga instructor
coaches.bio: Cole Chance is a certified yoga instructor with over a decade of experience guiding students from first-timers to seasoned practitioners. Her teaching blends grounded alignment with an emphasis on breath, mobility, and calm. She believes yoga should feel accessible, restorative, and genuinely joyful.

programs.title: 7-Day Rejuvenating Yoga Series
programs.description: A gentle week-long journey designed to rebuild energy, mobility, and mental clarity one day at a time. Each session layers on the last, moving from grounding foundations to a fully rejuvenated body and mind.

lessons.title: Day 1: Grounding Flow
lessons.description: Settle into your body with slow, deliberate movement and deep breathing to anchor your practice.

lessons.title: Day 2: Gentle Spine Mobility
lessons.description: Free up tension along the spine with cat-cow, twists, and supported backbends.

lessons.title: Day 3: Hip Opening Flow
lessons.description: Release stored tightness in the hips with lunges, pigeon variations, and mindful holds.

lessons.title: Day 4: Heart Opening & Breath
lessons.description: Expand the chest and shoulders while syncing movement to a steady, calming breath.

lessons.title: Day 5: Balance & Focus
lessons.description: Build steadiness and concentration through standing balance poses and a quiet mind.

lessons.title: Day 6: Full Body Vinyasa
lessons.description: Flow through a complete sequence that links strength, flexibility, and flowing breath.

lessons.title: Day 7: Deep Restoration
lessons.description: Wind down the series with long-held restorative poses and a guided final relaxation.

programs.title: Pregnancy Yoga
programs.description: A supportive prenatal series crafted to keep you strong, comfortable, and connected throughout pregnancy. Modifications are offered in every session so you can practice safely across each trimester.

lessons.title: Prenatal Foundations & Breath
lessons.description: Learn safe breathing techniques and gentle warm-ups to begin your prenatal practice.

lessons.title: Easing Lower Back Tension
lessons.description: Soothe the lower back and pelvis with supported stretches designed for a changing body.

lessons.title: Hip & Pelvic Floor Opening
lessons.description: Create space and mobility in the hips while gently engaging the pelvic floor.

lessons.title: Gentle Strength for Mom
lessons.description: Maintain functional strength in the legs and arms with low-impact, pregnancy-safe movements.

lessons.title: Calm & Connection
lessons.description: Slow down and bond with your baby through mindful movement and quiet breathing.

lessons.title: Restful Relaxation
lessons.description: Ease into deep rest with side-lying poses and a nurturing guided relaxation.

programs.title: Yin Yoga & Poetry
programs.description: A contemplative practice that pairs long, meditative yin holds with spoken poetry to quiet the mind. Each session invites stillness, reflection, and a deeper release through the connective tissue.

lessons.title: Stillness & First Words
lessons.description: Ease into long-held floor poses accompanied by a gentle opening verse.

lessons.title: Melting the Hips
lessons.description: Sink into deep hip openers while reflective poetry guides your breath and release.

lessons.title: Softening the Spine
lessons.description: Explore supported forward folds and twists paired with soothing spoken word.

lessons.title: The Quiet Heart
lessons.description: Open the chest and shoulders in stillness as poetry settles the mind.

lessons.title: Grounding the Legs
lessons.description: Hold nourishing seated stretches while verse anchors you to the present moment.

lessons.title: Closing Reflection
lessons.description: Rest in complete stillness with a final poem and a long, restorative meditation.

coaches.name: Abou El Naga
coaches.headline: Star Coach — personal trainer to famous actors
coaches.bio: Abou El Naga is a celebrity personal trainer known for transforming actors ahead of demanding film roles. With a background in strength and conditioning, he builds programs that balance intensity with sustainable progress. His no-excuses coaching style has made him one of the most sought-after trainers in the industry.
